title: Pi Dictation configuration
description: Configuration for the Pi Dictation extension.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors.

shortcut.description: Pi shortcut used to toggle dictation.

language.description: Language passed to the OpenAI-compatible transcription backend.

recordCommand.description: Custom recorder command. The optional {file} placeholder is replaced with the WAV path.

transcribeCommand.description: Local transcription command. The optional {file} placeholder is replaced with the WAV path.

openaiModel.description: Model sent to the OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint.

openaiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI-compatible API key. Prefer an environment variable or openaiApiKeyCommand.

openaiApiKeyCommand.description: Command that prints the OpenAI-compatible API key.

spinner.description: cli-spinners animation name used during processing.
